verdict.rationale: Twenty documents a REST/GraphQL API with create and batch endpoints for built-in objects like Company and Person. It lists an MCP server on every plan and describes AI agents that autonomously enrich records and run multi-step tasks within the permission model. That covers creating the lead and filling company data via agent or API. Owner assignment is never shown, and the MCP server is evidenced only by a pricing-table line. missing for 10: documented owner/assignee assignment via API or agent, MCP server tool documentation, an end-to-end lead-enrichment example, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner
